Pairs.Name: find_by_key
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."CreatedAt", f."Status", f."Total"
FROM fx_orders AS f
WHERE f."Id" = 1
LIMIT 1
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f."CreatedAt", f."Status", f."Total"
FROM fx_orders AS f
WHERE f."Id" = $1
LIMIT $2

Pairs.Name: filter_order_take
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE f."Price" > 10.0
ORDER BY f."Name"
LIMIT @p
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE f."Price" > $2
ORDER BY f."Name"
LIMIT $1

Pairs.Name: in_list
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE f."Id" = ANY (@ids)
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE f."Id" = ANY ($1)

Pairs.Name: like_contains
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE f."Name" LIKE '%widget%'
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE f."Name" LIKE $1

Pairs.Name: like_starts_with
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE f."Category" LIKE 'too%'
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f

Pairs.Name: lower_like
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE lower(f."Name") LIKE '%gizmo%'
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f

Pairs.Name: join
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f0."Name", f0."Price"
FROM fx_lines AS f
INNER JOIN fx_products AS f0 ON f."ProductId" = f0."Id"
WHERE f."Quantity" > 1
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f0."Name", f0."Price"
FROM fx_lines AS f
INNER JOIN fx_products AS f0 ON f."ProductId" = f0."Id"
WHERE f."Quantity" > $1

Pairs.Name: group_by_count
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Status", count(*)::int AS "Count"
FROM fx_orders AS f
GROUP BY f."Status"
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Status", count(*)::int AS "Count"
FROM fx_orders AS f
GROUP BY f."Status"

Pairs.Name: count_scalar
Pairs.App:
SELECT count(*)::int
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE f."Price" > 5.0
Pairs.Db:
SELECT count(*)::int
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE f."Price" > $1

Pairs.Name: any_exists
Pairs.App:
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fx_products AS f
    WHERE f."Price" > 100.0)
Pairs.Db:
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT $1
    FROM fx_products AS f
    WHERE f."Price" > $2)

Pairs.Name: max_aggregate
Pairs.App:
SELECT max(f."Price")
FROM fx_products AS f
Pairs.Db:
SELECT max(f."Price")
FROM fx_products AS f

Pairs.Name: date_filter
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."CreatedAt", f."Status", f."Total"
FROM fx_orders AS f
WHERE f."CreatedAt" > @since
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f."CreatedAt", f."Status", f."Total"
FROM fx_orders AS f
WHERE f."CreatedAt" > $1

Pairs.Name: pagination
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
ORDER BY f."Id"
LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
Pairs.Db:

FROM fx_products AS f
ORDER BY f."Id"
LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2

Pairs.Name: correlated_subquery
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fx_lines AS f0
    WHERE f0."ProductId" = f."Id")
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f."Category", f."Name", f."Price"
FROM fx_products AS f
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT $1
    FROM fx_lines AS f0
    WHERE f0."ProductId" = f."Id")

Pairs.Name: distinct_projection
Pairs.App:
SELECT DISTINCT f."Category"
FROM fx_products AS f
Pairs.Db:
SELECT DISTINCT f."Category"

Pairs.Name: order_by_multiple
Pairs.App:
SELECT f."Id", f."CreatedAt", f."Status", f."Total"
FROM fx_orders AS f
ORDER BY f."Total" DESC, f."CreatedAt"
LIMIT @p
Pairs.Db:
SELECT f."Id", f."CreatedAt", f."Status", f."Total"
FROM fx_orders AS f
ORDER BY f."Total" DESC, f."CreatedAt"
LIMIT $1

Pairs.Name: insert_single
Pairs.Db:

VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
RETURNING "Id"

Pairs.Name: insert_batch
Pairs.Db:

Pairs.Name: execute_update
Pairs.App:
UPDATE fx_orders AS f
SET "Total" = f."Total" + 1.0
WHERE f."Id" = 1
Pairs.Db:
UPDATE fx_orders AS f
SET "Total" = f."Total" + $1
WHERE f."Id" = $2

Pairs.Name: execute_delete
Pairs.App:
DELETE FROM fx_lines AS f
WHERE f."Quantity" < 0
Pairs.Db:
DELETE FROM fx_lines AS f
WHERE f."Quantity" < $1
